The Cable Bill, the Car Radio and the Local News: $90,000 Across These 3 Media Stocks Pays $4,545 a Year
items.sum: Your cable bill, car radio and local newscast may all send money to three dividend-paying media companies. Only one of them looks stretched, and its fat payout depends on election years, heavy debt and a shrinking audience.
